code: Extract the Sri Lanka 2024 presidential election results for Jaffna electoral district from the attached PDFs and populate the attached ODS template.  Files supplied:   10_A(1).pdf, 10_B(1).pdf, 10_C(1).pdf, 10_D(1).pdf, 10_E(1).pdf, 10_F.pdf, 10_G.pdf, 10_H.pdf, 10_I.pdf, 10_J.pdf, 10_K.pdf, and 10_PV.pdf.  Create one ODS workbook named Jaffna_2024.ods, with one sheet for each polling division A–K and one sheet for Postal Votes: 12 sheets in total. Identify the polling-division names from the PDFs.  Requirements:   1. Use OCR where necessary and check extracted values against the PDF scans. 2. Preserve the template’s candidate names, party abbreviations, capitalisation, row order, and formatting exactly. Populate only the votes and percentage columns. 3. There are 38 candidate rows. The source numbering skips candidate number 4; do not insert an extra candidate or shift subsequent rows. 4. Match results by candidate identity, rather than assuming that OCR row positions are correct. 5. Populate all four summary rows:   - Total Number of Valid Votes - Number of Rejected Votes - Number of Votes Polled - Number of Registered Electors 6. Preserve the percentages printed in the PDFs. Store them as numeric percentages with percentage formatting. Leave a printed dash blank; do not convert it to zero. 7. Store vote counts as numbers, not text. 8. For every sheet, verify that:   - All 38 candidates and four summary rows are present. - Candidate votes sum to Total Number of Valid Votes. - Valid votes + rejected votes = Number of Votes Polled. - Candidate percentages agree with candidate votes / valid votes, allowing for rounding. - Valid and rejected percentages use votes polled as the denominator. - Turnout percentage uses registered electors as the denominator. 9. Do not change a printed figure simply to make a check pass. Report any source discrepancy separately from OCR errors. 10. Check for duplicate, missing, or incorrectly labelled result tables. Add a brief source filename note to each sheet. 11. Do not create a district-total result sheet unless an official district-total table is supplied. Any calculated aggregate must be clearly labelled as calculated. 12. Return the completed downloadable ODS workbook and a brief account of validation results and any unresolved issues.  Process all 12 PDFs. A previous chat processed only A–E; this upload supplies A–K and postal votes, so the new workbook should contain all 12 result tables.
